permission.headline: Turn these on and we start counting.
permission.screenTimeBody: So we can see your time in reels apps
permission.countingBody: So we can count each reel as you scroll
permission.overlayBody: So the counter can float while you scroll
permission.whyHeadline: These two are what make the count real
permission.whyScreenTime: Screen time tells us how long you sat in the reels apps.
permission.whyCounting: Counting reels is the only way Android lets us see one go past. We check that the screen changed, so a resting thumb is not a reel.
permission.whyOverlay: Display over other apps lets the count float while you scroll.
permission.whyPrivate: Nothing we read to do that is saved, and none of it leaves your phone.
permission.whyRevoke: You can turn either one off later in settings.
